methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The aim of this paper is to present a model for the development and implementation of EnPIs for in-house energy management in a kraft pulp mill.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The study was carried out as a multiple case study, as described by Yin (2014). Three kraft pulp mills constitute the studied cases.
